name: Hate the Hatefury
summary: Aka'rai in Shadowprey Village asks you to strike at the Hatefury satyr in Sargeron. His grievance comes from a bargain that left him seeking revenge.

sections.title: Aka'rai's Grievance
sections.body: Aka'rai speaks of a bargain with a satyr that promised him power and knowledge. He says the Hatefury cast him aside, leaving him with less than before. Now he asks you to attack their camp northeast of Shadowprey Village, in Sargeron. Their blood is the price he seeks for his revenge.

sections.title: The Blood Bargain
sections.body: After the fighting, Aka'rai says one Hatefury escaped your assault. He names that satyr as the one who joined him in a ritual marked by spilled blood. The satyr holds Aka'rai's soulstone, so Aka'rai fears leaving Shadowprey Village while it remains in his hands. For now, he says your work is done.

faq.answer: Aka'rai in Shadowprey Village asks you to attack the Hatefury satyr at Sargeron.

faq.q: Why does Aka'rai want the Hatefury attacked?
faq.answer: Aka'rai says the Hatefury cast him aside after a bargain that promised power and knowledge.
The Hatefury camp is at Sargeron in Desolace, northeast of Shadowprey Village.
Aka'rai says the bargain promised power, knowledge beyond ordinary tomes, and an eager minion.

attribution: In-game quest text: Hate the Hatefury
